question: Does deploying the full dynamic Lead Opportunity + inventory/fallback system causally increase lead-level scheduled visits within 30 days versus current Growth prioritization?
hypothesis: The full treatment increases lead_scheduled_visit_30d_from_assignment by at least 2 percentage points absolute.
primary_change: Replace current Growth prioritization with a frozen, drift-sanitized Lead Opportunity policy plus inventory serviceability and governed fallback. Stages that fail the offline/future-cohort gate remain LeadQuality-neutral.
secondary_changes: Treatment queue ordering changes as the lead progresses.
Fallback ranking is surfaced when requested inventory cannot be served.
Availability freshness is explicitly handled rather than assumed.

target.name: lead_scheduled_visit_30d_from_assignment
target.censoring: wait for full 30-day maturation; do not label immature leads negative
target.definition: One per randomized lead: 1 iff at least one unique backend broker_response == scheduled_visit event has response_event_at in (assignment_at, assignment_at + 30 days]; multiple events count once.
target.assignment_semantics: assignment_at is persisted in UTC by the randomization service before any experimental score, queue ordering or routing. First assignment wins and is immutable.

population.eligibility: New production leads that would normally enter the Growth prioritization queue.
exclusions_before_randomization: internal/test/duplicate leads under fixed production rules
leads outside the product's intended Growth queue
leads with any scheduled_visit already observed before assignment_at
population.post_randomization_exclusions: none for ITT except symmetric proven instrumentation corruption

randomization.implementation: Server-side sticky assignment persisted before scoring; prefer permuted blocks within the declared strata. Repeated calls must return the original arm.

metrics.primary: absolute ITT risk difference in lead_scheduled_visit_30d_from_assignment

decision_rule: SHIP only when point delta >= +0.02, the two-sided 95% CI lower bound is >0, and hard guardrails pass. NO-SHIP if CI upper bound < +0.02. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

items: all dynamic model inputs obey point-in-time rules

stage_policy.T1: LeadQuality neutral in v1; serviceability/fallback may refresh.
stage_policy.T2: Frozen E029 candidate may influence ranking only after prospective gate PASS.
